description.en: Overcoming compound ALK mutations (G1202R/L1196M) in lorlatinib-resistant NSCLC
description.zh: 克服洛拉替尼耐药 NSCLC 中的 ALK 复合突变 (G1202R/L1196M)

context.en: Exploring 4th-gen ALK inhibitors to address compound mutations emerging under lorlatinib pressure, focusing on maintaining brain penetration.
context.zh: 探索第四代 ALK 抑制剂，解决洛拉替尼治疗压力下出现的复合突变，同时维持脑渗透性。
